title: Penetration Testing Basics
description: Understand how penetration testing uncovers real-world vulnerabilities.

data.text:
**Penetration Testing Basics**

Penetration testing simulates real attacks to find vulnerabilities that automated tools miss.

items: White box: full source code access

data.title: Testing Access Control
data.content:
# Test 1: Access another user's resource
GET /api/orders/999 (not my order)

# Test 2: Escalate role via parameter
POST /api/admin/create-user
{
  "role": "admin",
  "name": "attacker"
}

# Test 3: Remove required parameter
POST /api/users
{ "name": "test" }  # missing email

data.title: Ethical Testing
data.text: Only test applications you own or have written permission to test. Unauthorized testing is illegal.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Focus on authentication, authorization, and injection
data.takeaway: Penetration testing reveals what automated scanners cannot.
